parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: DeviceTag
parameters.description:
The endpoint device ID. You can obtain this value from the following operations:
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user endpoint device.
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries user endpoint devices in batches.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.
